name: Customer Follow-up Agent
fn: Drafts follow-up emails for missing remittances and triggers auto-sends
detail: Drafts and (on approval) sends remittance-request emails when a payment arrives without backup, tracking responses back into the match queue. Closes the most common cause of unapplied cash.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
